title: How the encomienda shaped Colombia's long-run development
summary: In Colombia, municipalities subjected to the Spanish encomienda – a colonial system of forced indigenous labour – are wealthier and better governed today, in spite of the extractive institution imposed on them.

title: Understanding development in the long run: Cracks in the consensus on institutions?
